name: Kanda Ren
source:
"Huh? Prehaps ignoring a read message has something to do with love?" 

High Spec x Stalker 

A senior of third year high school.
Has a fashionable sense & easily getting along with everyone that earned himself as a popular guy in his class. 

... Or it should have been, due to his devastating LQ (love quotient) he always following the heroine around which turned her off. 
He was heroine's brother junior and was very fond of him during the time. Currently served as Student Council Secretary & Vice Captain of Basketball Club.
